test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Even getting what they want doesn’t satisfy some kids; they only want more.

B. Too many parents these days can’t say no.

C. The struggle to set limits has never been tougher—and the stakes have never been higher.

D. As a result, they find themselves raising children who respond greedily to the advertisements aimed right at them.
solution:
The correct answer is "BDAC."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The reason for the correct order of the sentences being **BDAC** is as follows:
